meta.rule: A value is only shown on the site when a session runner read it on the page listed here. Every entry carries the retrieval date and a verbatim excerpt. Values that could not be read on an official page are left blank and listed on the Flagged for Review page.

tiers.official: Published by the casino/hotel operator or the tournament organiser (e.g. venetianlasvegas.com, wynnlasvegas.com, caesars.com, mgmresorts.com, worldpokertour.com).
tiers.official_map_data: OpenStreetMap / OSRM open data used only for walking distance & duration. NOT a casino source and NOT Google/Apple turn-by-turn; labelled as such everywhere it appears.
tiers.third_party_reference: Used only as a lead. Never used for a displayed fact unless an official source confirms it.
